answer.submission_route: Appeal in writing, including your name, health plan ID, a reference to the claim (claim number), and the date and provider of service. By mail: Appeals Coordinator, Arkansas Blue Cross and Blue Shield, PO Box 2181, Little Rock, AR 72203-2181 By phone: the number on the back of your insurance card Deadline: 180 days after you are notified of the denial -- but your denial letter is authoritative.
answer.how_to_obtain_criteria: This plan does not publish criteria for this procedure. Ask the plan in writing for the exact criteria used in your denial.
answer.notes: no public criteria on file; abstained and routed
